topic: Updating Estonia frequency identifier across environments
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on updating the geographical identifier for Estonia within analytics scripts and deployment pipelines. Initially, [p1] requested deploying `frequency Estonia_7964` to production. Later, [p1] provided a SQL snippet requiring the replacement of the string "Estonia" with "Estonia_7952". This change was first implemented on staging environments (staging-analytics) and then subsequently deployed to the main production environment (analytics). Multiple re-deployments of `ml-api` were performed across both stage and main branches.
decisions: The identifier for Estonia must be updated from "Estonia" to "Estonia_7952" in relevant scripts.
